tagline: A long loop following a failed campaign.
intro: From Little Rock, the byway runs southwest toward Washington, then turns back through Prescott and east to Camden. The return goes by Fordyce and the Saline River country near Leola and Sheridan. It traces communities caught in a Union campaign that never reached its intended meeting at Shreveport.

At Poison Springs, Confederate and Choctaw troops overcame a Union supply train, and the battle hastened the expedition's failure. At Jenkins' Ferry on the Saline, the fighting let the Federal army finish its retreat from Camden to Little Rock.

moments.title: Poison Springs Battleground
moments.text: Highway 76 follows the old supply-train road at a battlefield remembered for the killing of Black Union soldiers after their defeat.

moments.title: Jenkins' Ferry Battleground
moments.text: Beside a bend in the Saline River, the park preserves part of the old road and the eastern end of the ferry crossing.
